data_es.tip_pt: Para el pasado, usa modal + have + participio: must have been, can't have known, might have left.

data_es.summary_pt: Usamos must, might y can't para sacar conclusiones lógicas sobre distintas situaciones.
data_es.cover_prompt: A cute hand-drawn detective with a magnifying glass looking at footprints and clues, simple doodle style, no text or letters

common_mistake.right: He can't be home; the lights are off.
common_mistake.wrong: He mustn't be home; the lights are off.
common_mistake.why_pt: Lo contrario de must be (deducción) es can't be, no mustn't.
